svg.text: Base chassis power distribution, drive control and odometry feedback. Pin assignments per Master_Reference.md §4 and Bench_Test_Map.md.
Motor leads: Red → MxA, Black → MxB, identical on all four. Left/right direction handled in firmware via MOTOR_DIR_SIGN[].
Front and rear encoders use different A/B wire colours.
Verify against the physical wire, not memory.
ESP32 GND · boost GND · buck GND · both MDD20A logic GND · shifter LV−/HV− · all 4 encoder Black — every one of these on a single rail.
Missing any one of these connections produces phantom motor behaviour (Master_Reference.md §3.2). Pi GND reaches ESP32 GND through the USB cable.
Powering the ESP32 from Pi USB couples SMPS switching noise and
PWM ground transients into the encoder counts. For deployment, cut
VBUS in the Pi→ESP32 cable and feed VIN from the 5 V buck instead.
